service.description: A recruiter's openings (PERMISSION_DENIED without PEOPLE_RECRUIT_VIEW) of the employers in scope (one asked for, ORGANIZATION_DENIED outside): by state (draft and open unless asked), a title search ignoring case, or one by id; each with its employer, owner, seats, dates, state (an open one past its closing is shown closed), mail intake tag, scorecard, open and all applications, whether the caller changes it and its revision. Paged, an export up to the cap.

actions.script: for (const key of ['', 'Count', 'PageIndex', 'PageSize', 'PageMaxIndex', 'PageRangeLow', 'PageRangeHigh']) context['openings' + key] = found['openings' + key]

service.description: A new opening (a draft, or open with action open) of an employer in the recruiter's scope, or a change of one at the revision read (REVISION_CHANGED); action open, close or reopen. PEOPLE_RECRUIT_VIEW and PEOPLE_RECRUIT_EDIT. Its seats (emplPositionIds) are approved active positions of the employer (POSITION_REQUIRED, POSITION_UNAVAILABLE, POSITION_NOT_APPROVED), checked again when it opens; the owner works for the employer (OWNER_INVALID); the plus tag is unique among draft and open openings (TAG_INVALID, TAG_TAKEN); the scorecard a published interview scorecard of the employer (FORM_UNAVAILABLE); the closing after the opening (DATES_INVALID). Close keeps the applications.

A recruiter's applications (PERMISSION_DENIED without PEOPLE_RECRUIT_VIEW) of the employers in scope: of an opening (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE outside), by stage (the open stages unless asked), an applicant name search ignoring case; each with the applicant, opening, stage, owner, applied date, next interview, source, a possible duplicate, whether the caller changes and moves it, and its revision; stages: the board's columns with their counts. Paged. Panel members read their applications through get#Application, never this list.

parameter.name: statusId
parameter.description: One stage, or a comma list

actions.script: for (const key of ['', 'Count', 'PageIndex', 'PageSize', 'PageMaxIndex', 'PageRangeLow', 'PageRangeHigh']) context['applications' + key] = found['applications' + key]

service.description: A recruiter (PEOPLE_RECRUIT_EDIT) records an application to an open opening of an employer in scope (OPENING_CLOSED for one that takes none): the applicant a person chosen (one related to the employer: an employee, an agent or an applicant to it; any other RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, as a missing one), else the person of the exact email given, else a new person (NAME_REQUIRED) with the email, with the Applicant role; the source and the referring employee (SOURCE_INVALID, REFERRER_INVALID), the contact permission and notes. Received; another open application of the person to the employer is flagged (duplicateOfApplicationId), never merged.

An application the caller reads (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE otherwise, as a missing one): a recruiter of its employer reads everything (the applicant's email, source, referral, contact permission, notes, a possible duplicate, the files, every interview and every scorecard with its answers, which files are shared with the panel), a panel member of one of its interviews (the user's call of Nov 12, 2026) the applicant's name, the opening and its employer, the interviews they are on the panel of with their own scorecards only (myScorecards: to answer or answered) and the files shared with the panel (sharedFiles), never the stage, source, contact, notes, other files or interviews, nor another reviewer's scorecard. The scorecards are the application's record: the framework's get#FormResponse is never the way to read one.

A recruiter (PEOPLE_RECRUIT_EDIT) changes an application at the revision read: another open opening of the same employer (EMPLOYER_CHANGE, OPENING_CLOSED; a closed application keeps its opening), the source and referral, the contact permission and notes.

A recruiter (PEOPLE_RECRUIT_EDIT) moves applications (employmentApplicationIds, or one at its revision) to a stage, with the reason kept as the stage's audit change reason; each in its own transaction. A stage moves along its flow (STAGE_INVALID, SAME_STAGE; a hired, refused or withdrawn one APPLICATION_CLOSED); Interview needs a scheduled interview (INTERVIEW_REQUIRED), Offer an offer (OFFER_REQUIRED), and Hired is never a stage change (HIRED_BY_OFFER). Each refused or failed application is named in failures with its code; the rest go on.

A recruiter (PEOPLE_RECRUIT_EDIT) schedules an interview of an application before its offer (APPLICATION_CLOSED): a private event (WetEvent, WevRestricted) owned by the caller from startDate (DATE_PAST) for durationMinutes (10 to 480, DURATION_INVALID), at a location or, with videoCall, on a call link (org.moqui.call.CallServices.create#CallLink, in the event's location); the panel (panelPartyIds: employees of the employer with an account, PANEL_REQUIRED, PANEL_INVALID) and with inviteCandidate the applicant (CANDIDATE_NO_EMAIL) as attendees; each panel member assigned the scorecard (formId, else the opening's, else the employer's only published interview scorecard; SCORECARD_REQUIRED, FORM_UNAVAILABLE) with no link. A received or screening application moves to Interview. The invitations follow (mantle.work.EventServices.send#EventInvitations: users notified, the candidate emailed with the .ics); a failure to send is named (invitationsSent false) and the interview stays.

A panel member answers the scorecard assigned to them (invitationId: another's or a missing one is RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), once (ALREADY_ANSWERED), the values checked against the form as of now (its show and require rules and each value's type; FORM_VALUES_INVALID with the reasons) and kept as one FormResponse the invitation links; the response is never changed after (FormPublication.eecas.xml).

InterviewsCalendar's items from start to end (days, yyyy-MM-dd, or instants): the interviews the caller is on the panel of and, for a recruiter, those of the employers in scope, each "{applicant} · {opening}" (kind interview), never cancelled ones.

My interviews, a projected CalDAV collection (CalendarProjection PeopleMyInterviews): admitted for a user on an interview panel; the interviews they are on the panel of, "Interview · {opening}", never the candidate's name, another reviewer's scorecard or another opening's candidates.

Whether the caller reads an application's record, its notes and files (its content host, PE-01): a recruiter of its employer; canEdit for a recruiter with PEOPLE_RECRUIT_EDIT. A panel member reads none of it: they read the application through get#Application and get#MyInterview and the shared files through get#ApplicationFile. Never refuses: a missing application, or one not the caller's to read, answers recordVisible false, and so does a call with no user. get#RecordLinkInfo and RecordFiles read it.

A private file of an application (its resume, a cover letter): the row, and the uploaded file saved through save#ApplicationContentFile. A recruiter of the employer with PEOPLE_RECRUIT_EDIT (check#ApplicationAccess: RECORD_UNAVAILABLE outside, PERMISSION_DENIED for a reader).
Internal to create#ApplicationContent, which checks the caller: the file of an application's content row.

return.message: RECORD_UNAVAILABLE: File ${applicationContentId} is not of application ${employmentApplicationId}

actions.script: const fileStream = contentFile.getInputStream() try { docRr.putStream(fileStream) } finally { fileStream.close() }

service.description: The createApplication action of the mail client's rules (EmailRuleAction ErActCreateApplication, F65; run by org.moqui.mail.EmailClientServices.run#EmailRules with authorization off, so it checks itself what it does): a received message, once (a message already an application answers it), becomes a Received application to its opening (the one the action's value names, else the open opening whose plus tag a To or Cc address carries) when the opening takes applications and the rule may file into it: the opening's intake account is the message's, or the rule's owner is its recruiting owner now, with an enabled account, PEOPLE_RECRUIT_EDIT and still working for the employer. The sender is the applicant (the person of the address, else a new person with the Applicant role), the subject the notes, the attachments the application's private files (the first its resume); a possible duplicate is flagged. Otherwise nothing is made and the reason is logged and answered.

parameter.name: value
parameter.description: The opening (jobOpeningId), or empty for the plus tag

service.description: A recruiter (PEOPLE_RECRUIT_EDIT of the employer) shares a file of an application with its interview panels (shared true), or stops sharing it; the change is audit-logged. RECORD_UNAVAILABLE for a file not theirs to change, as a missing one. A panel member reads only the shared files (the user's call of Nov 12, 2026).

A file of an application to send: for a recruiter of its employer, or for a member of one of its interview panels when it is shared with the panel; its location, file name and whether it may show inline (a raster image or a PDF; anything else only downloads). RECORD_UNAVAILABLE otherwise, as for a missing one.

The caller's own interviews (no party parameter; the user's call of Nov 12, 2026: a panel member answers from their self-service, People/SelfService and Commons/People/SelfService): those they are on the panel of, coming or of the last 30 days, and any older one whose scorecard is still to submit; each with when, the applicant's name, the opening, its employer and the scorecard's state (toAnswerCount: those to submit). Nothing else of the application.

One interview the caller is on the panel of (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE otherwise, as a missing one): when and where (a video interview's call link), the note to the attendees, the panel, the applicant's name, the opening and its employer, the files a recruiter shared with the panel and the caller's own scorecard (its form to answer once with submit#Scorecard, or their answers). Never the application's stage, source, contact, notes or other files, nor another reviewer's scorecard.

The "Create application" create-from of a chat message (ironstone.comms.ChatServices.create#FromChat kind application): a recruiter (PEOPLE_RECRUIT_EDIT) makes a Received application of the message's sender (never their own message: NOT_AN_APPLICANT) to the opening of the room's record (a JobOpening's room), else the open opening whose plus tag the message names (+tag), else the one open opening the caller owns (OPENING_REQUIRED), one the caller changes (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE otherwise) that takes applications (OPENING_CLOSED); the message's first line its notes, its files the application's private files (the first its resume, none shared with the panel). Once per message; a message of a room the caller does not read is RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, one of an end-to-end encrypted room ROOM_ENCRYPTED.
